goal: Rank high-priority chart-derived claims that real participants challenge or practitioners disagree about, then adjudicate whether their alleged falsifications are specific, whether pre-existing source exceptions resolve them, and whether any demonstrated predictive advantage remains over ordinary explanations.
source_eligibility_order: first-person self-report with original public forum URL and dated chart/prediction
commentator reporting independently observed prediction and outcome with date
practitioner forum disagreement with clear rule/source and preexisting qualification
original tradition documentation that defines disputed rule
nonforum software/practice technical note (never count as person-level prediction failure)

frozen_strata.breadth_goal: At least 2 independent discussions with contrary reports plus positive controls and competing HD doctrinal interpretations for any candidate declared system-level top predictor
Different planets and houses, plus ascendant ruler/whole chart qualification, no single-sign strawman
Separate natal personality predictions from annual timing; source-first Lilly/Ptolemy qualifications
Vedic different methods and birthtime/ayanamsa/house rules must be logged before any interpretation disagreement
Day boundary, solar-term and true solar-time verified independently; do not conflate reading skill with rule
No direct firsthand counterexamples yet verified; implementation bugs are NOT proof of method failure
Official Gene Keys is contemplative, not conventional predictive profile; only score if proponent provides preregistered observable prediction
Inventory only at this stage; do NOT claim coverage or top dissents

sampling_design.freeze_claim_first: A pre-existing text must specify exact chart predicate, human phenomenon, time/context, allowed exceptions and prediction direction before observing a participant's dispute.
two_search_lanes: find explicit first-person mismatch / prediction failure
find independent first-person matches / objective outcomes / strongest preexisting source qualification
sampling_design.evidence_units: one independently identifiable experiencer per predictor, deduplicate repeated comments and quotes by same person
sampling_design.provisional_seed_limit: A screening pilot from accessible original thread excerpts; it is NOT a count of all comments, users, charts, events or prevalence.
sampling_design.report_both_signs: Record positive/negative/mixed/unverifiable and explicit contrary examples; no positivity/negativity extrapolation without a denominator
sampling_design.time_window: initial cross-era seed coverage; only add 2026 recency when relevant
sampling_design.prior_authority_verification: Verify user's claimed HD Authority or actual natal birth data if voluntarily provided and permitted; without this classify as self-identified only
sampling_design.outcome_separation: Prediction of current trait vs event forecast vs operational advice vs calculation difference vs practitioner interpretation
sampling_design.adjudication: Do not accept 'your real chart is different', 'you haven't deconditioned', 'you are too young', 'the prophecy is spiritual', etc. as exemptions unless exact rule and trigger were predeclared BEFORE outcome; preserve genuine source-qualified exceptions.
sampling_design.false_positive_controls: Ordinary psychology, trait distributions, personality measures, coincidence, broad Barnum phrases, general timing patterns and selection bias.
sampling_design.human_scoring: Prospective blind matching with sufficient independent respondents, preregistered event/trait definitions, condition-specific calibration and a chart-free baseline; report failure rates and uncertainty.
sampling_design.safe_stop: An unresolved or nonfalsifiable prediction remains SOURCE_ONLY with no chart score. Do not silently promote.

triage_dimensions.outcome_operational_clarity: 0 vague/no disconfirming observation; 1 definable with major missing protocol; 2 explicit falsifiable event or trait
triage_dimensions.directness_of_negative_report: 0 no mismatch; 1 disagreement or retrospective interpretation; 2 firstperson definite contrast; 3 dated prospective claimed prediction and explicit failure
triage_dimensions.qualification_source_status: PREDECLARED_APPLICABLE or PREDECLARED_NOT_ESTABLISHED or POST_HOC_RESCUE or UNKNOWN
triage_dimensions.impact_on_development: 0 no owner-relevant rule; 1 affects symbolic interpretation; 2 currently scored or sharply impacts decisions

priority_key: Decision-sensitive but PROVISIONAL: high impact plus direct first-person contradiction and operational ambiguity. Use labels rather than numerical prevalence until a denominator exists.
